objective: Create an evidence-backed iteration gate for moving the PC assembly room from QA candidate toward Bruno Simon-inspired commercial room quality.

comparisonPolicy.benchmarkUse: Commercial and Bruno Simon references are used as qualitative targets only; this board embeds only local authored/open/community evidence paths.

benchmarkGates.target: cutaway room reads as a finished deskterior scene from the first screenshot
benchmarkGates.evidence: The browser screenshot has wall/surface/furniture/detail layers, and glare is now measured at clipped=0.026.
benchmarkGates.nextAction: Remove leftover staging primitives, tune camera crop, and continue reducing central practical light glare without flattening contrast.

benchmarkGates.target: sofa, coffee table, shelf, desk, and media console have bespoke silhouettes, bevels, seams, legs, backs, and scale detail
benchmarkGates.evidence: The furniture kit now has 328 authored objects, 64048 triangles, and records 17 sofa + 9 coffee-table curved topology targets.
benchmarkGates.nextAction: Use internal-browser screenshot review to decide whether another sculpt pass or a full high-poly/UV furniture rebuild is required.

benchmarkGates.target: wood, fabric, lacquer, glass, screen, wall, and floor surfaces each react plausibly under warm/cool lighting
benchmarkGates.evidence: Furniture helper maps include baseColor, normal, roughness, ambientOcclusion, packedOrm roles with 4 packed ORM sidecars; surface kit reports baseColor, normal, roughness, ambientOcclusion, contactShadowLightmap, artDirectedBounceLightmap, cyclesAoBakeLightmap, packedOrm roles with 21 embedded textures and 3 packed ORM sidecars.
benchmarkGates.nextAction: Replace procedural helper maps with art-directed UV bakes, reduce flat fabric blocks, and keep KTX2 sidecar freshness under QA.

benchmarkGates.target: scene has authored contact shadows, soft bounce, practical lights, and minimal runtime-only flatness
benchmarkGates.evidence: Runtime glare is lower, the named cinematic contact-occlusion pass is wired, and the surface GLB now carries 7 floor + 4 wall contact-shadow lightmap zones plus 6 wall soft-wash zones and 5 floor + 4 wall art-directed bounce zones. It also has a CYCLES AO probe from 7 blocker proxies. It is still not a path-traced GI pass.
benchmarkGates.nextAction: Promote the AO probe into true baked AO/GI UV textures, then reduce runtime-only shadow overlays.

benchmarkGates.target: assets are split, selectable, optimized, licensed, documented, and ready for catalog/runtime LOD
benchmarkGates.evidence: Current GLB kits are QA layers with reports, surface ORM sidecars (orm-png-sidecar-ready-ktx2-pending), and furniture ORM sidecars (ktx2-ready). Furniture runtime KTX2 can be produced, but there is still no meshopt package, collider sidecar, LOD ladder, or catalog split metadata.
benchmarkGates.nextAction: Split kits into catalog-ready assets and add proxy, collider, KTX2/meshopt, release eligibility, and provenance records.

benchmarkGates.target: PC build is a believable deskterior sub-flow without overpowering room/furniture quality
benchmarkGates.evidence: 38 assembly steps, 11 room setup steps, attachment/compatibility/fit checks, audio events, and saved payload are verified.
benchmarkGates.nextAction: Upgrade PC part GLBs and cable routing once the room/furniture visual base is stronger.

weakestAreas.whyItBlocksCommercialQuality: The sofa and coffee-table zone is closest to the camera. Bespoke rounded topology reduces the box-read, but it still needs human screenshot review against approved furniture references.
weakestAreas.nextBlenderIteration: Either refine the curved cushion/table meshes with stronger underside/contact shaping or move to a full high-poly sculpt, UV unwrap, and decimated runtime proxy.

weakestAreas.whyItBlocksCommercialQuality: Glare is measured and reduced, authored surface contact/bounce zones exist, a Cycles AO probe exists, and wall reveal lines are softer, but the scene still lacks a path-traced global illumination texture pass.
weakestAreas.nextBlenderIteration: Promote the Cycles AO probe and hand-authored bounce atlas into true AO/GI UV atlases, keep wall guide lines below grid visibility, rebalance emissive practicals, and keep clipped highlight ratio under the QA threshold.

weakestAreas.whyItBlocksCommercialQuality: Floor/wall and furniture normal/roughness/AO/ORM helper maps exist now, but they are procedural package evidence and not yet real UV-unwrapped commercial texture bakes.
weakestAreas.nextBlenderIteration: Promote the ORM sidecars into art-directed UV bakes, keep KTX2 transcode checks in CI, and compare them against high-quality room-pack references.

weakestAreas.whyItBlocksCommercialQuality: A single dense kit is acceptable for QA, but a product editor needs selectable assets, collider metadata, LODs, KTX2, meshopt, and provenance.
weakestAreas.nextBlenderIteration: Split furniture/surface/detail kits into catalog-sized runtime packages with proxy GLBs, colliders, release gates, and source metadata.

weakestAreas.whyItBlocksCommercialQuality: Commercial quality cannot be claimed from a screenshot alone; every visual pass needs a before/after board and gap ledger.
weakestAreas.nextBlenderIteration: Keep this contact sheet updated after each asset generation pass and promote only when visual blockers are closed.
